description: This Java class implements a service for executing database-independent queries within the Fineract project, selecting appropriate query strategies based on the data source.

classes.name: DatabaseIndependentQueryService
classes.description: A service class that provides database queries that work independently of the specific database type by choosing the appropriate query implementation based on the DataSource.

methods.name: DatabaseIndependentQueryService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a collection of available DatabaseQueryService implementations.

methods.name: choose
methods.description: Selects and returns the appropriate DatabaseQueryService implementation supported by the given DataSource.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Indicates that this query service is supported.

methods.name: isTablePresent
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database via the selected query service.

methods.name: getTableColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column information for a specified table.

methods.name: getTableIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index details for a specified table.
